summary: Scalar deleting-destructor idiom: runs DestructorWithResourceCleanup on this, then frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the deletion flag's low bit is set, and returns this.

operations.description: Call DestructorWithResourceCleanup (0x0045B400) on this to run resource teardown.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0; when the low bit of the deletion flag is clear, the free is skipped.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) on this to release the object memory when the flag bit is set.

unresolved: Object type and the resource cleanup performed by DestructorWithResourceCleanup are unknown (packet carries no fields).
Whether FreeWrapper_7bcf is operator delete or a custom free is unverified.
